analysis:
PORTFOLIO REVIEW: Six positions at 86% deployed materially exceeds the 3-5 concentrated-position target. This alone is sufficient reason to pause new additions — a 7th position would dilute focus and further reduce the already-thin $9,071 headroom to a size too small to matter (sub-10% of equity even at full deployment). No new buys this cycle.

POSITION-BY-POSITION FLAGS:
• ADSK (+8.46%): Thesis intact, trending well. Hold.
• UHS (+11.64%): Strongest performer. Hold, trail stop.
• ULTA (+8.76%): Solid. Hold.
• FOXA (+4.04%): Modest but intact. Hold.
• NXPI (-1.21%): Mildly underwater but screened as UPTREND (basing) this cycle — technical picture improving. Watch closely; a close below the 200-day would break the thesis.
• AMP (-6.20%): Most concerning. NOT appearing in the screened candidate list this cycle, which may indicate trend or quality deterioration since entry. At -6.20% from cost basis (~$547 avg, now $513), this is approaching meaningful drawdown territory. If AMP was entered with a ~10-12% stop, we are roughly halfway there. No hard stop yet — but this is the position to watch most carefully. If the Q3 earnings thesis (earnings growth supporting the valuation) has softened materially, this warrants a voluntary exit rather than waiting for the stop.

MARKET REGIME: Unavailable this cycle, adding uncertainty. With a Sortino ratio of -6.37 and a profit factor barely above 1.0 (1.07x), the risk-adjusted performance is poor. The honest read: capital preservation and patience are the edge right now, not more activity.

CANDIDATE REVIEW: Several interesting setups exist (TKO with 29% EPS revision upward, NXPI already owned, ISRG clean uptrend basing) but none clear the full hurdle: (a) headroom is too small to size any position to 1-2% portfolio heat properly, (b) adding a 7th position contradicts the strategy's concentrated-book mandate, and (c) market regime is unknown. Cash is the correct position today. Wait for one of the existing 6 to exit (stop or target) before initiating a new name.
